typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		{Dep Date} as string,
		{Buildpack Name} as string,
		{Product Pack} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> LastBPAvail
LastBPAvail sink(input(
		Dep_Date as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		Buildpack_Name as string,
		Product_Pack as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Dep_Date = {Dep Date},
		Buildpack_Name = {Buildpack Name},
		Product_Pack = {Product Pack}),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
